designs.name: Royal fan
designs.description: Two generous fans of three cards, joined by a gold diamond.

designs.name: Heart locket
designs.description: Two hearts in a delicate elongated locket, with tiny gold clasps.

designs.name: Diamond cut
designs.description: An interlocking trio of cut diamonds, graphic and particularly clear at small sizes.

designs.name: Suit ribbon
designs.description: An airy vertical ribbon holding a heart and a club, with symmetrical curled tails.

designs.name: The cut
designs.description: A neat three-card deck with paired pips and a restrained gold edge.

designs.name: Trump crest
designs.description: A pair of small heraldic shields, each holding a bold club.

designs.name: Joker’s bells
designs.description: A playful three-point jester cap, with bell tips and a central diamond.

designs.name: House chip
designs.description: One substantial casino chip in the middle of a quiet solid-color back.

designs.name: Roulette rose
designs.description: A simplified roulette wheel with broad alternating wedges and a gold spindle.

designs.name: Club lounge
designs.description: A club-house badge with a pair of club silhouettes and a broad oval frame.

designs.name: Open book
designs.description: Two open books, echoed top-to-bottom in a pared-back version of the current book motif.

designs.name: Page rosette
designs.description: Eight broad folded pages create one sculptural rosette, surrounded by open color.

designs.name: Seven-card book
designs.description: A Hand & Foot book: seven cards fan out above a small gold binding.

designs.name: Grand folio
designs.description: One generous open folio, with broad curved pages and simple gold lettering lines.

designs.name: Concertina
designs.description: An accordion-fold book opens into a crisp, sculptural zigzag.

designs.name: Between bookends
designs.description: A small shelf of distinct book spines, held between sculpted bookends.

designs.name: Midnight reader
designs.description: A crescent moon and three small stars over an open book.

designs.name: By candlelight
designs.description: A warm little candle rises behind an open book, with a gold pool of light.

designs.name: Paper heart
designs.description: Two curled leaves of a book meet to form a heart, with a delicate spine below.

designs.name: Literary butterfly
designs.description: Four folded pages become butterfly wings, with the spine as a slender gold body.

designs.name: Story tree
designs.description: A branching story tree grows from an open book, with broad page-shaped leaves.

designs.name: Pressed pages
designs.description: A graceful pressed sprig rests across one open book.

designs.name: Chapter seal
designs.description: A tiny wax seal fastens a ribbon around a tilted book, with a heart impressed in the seal.

designs.name: Page compass
designs.description: Four little open books radiate from one gold center, creating a compass of pages.

designs.name: Leaf pair
designs.description: Two generous leaves on a simple diagonal stem, with plenty of breathing room.

designs.name: Fern sprig
designs.description: One large frond, built from a few broad leaf pairs instead of fine frills.

designs.name: Ginkgo
designs.description: Two fan-shaped leaves; their silhouette does the work.

designs.name: Four leaf
designs.description: A single oversized four-leaf motif, without background texture.

designs.name: Laurel seal
designs.description: A classic open wreath, made from six generous leaves.

designs.name: Acorn
designs.description: A small woodland emblem: a broad acorn and one leaf, repeated at the other end.

designs.name: Jasmine
designs.description: A light six-petal blossom with two long leaves; simple and spacious.

designs.name: Lotus
designs.description: Two compact lotus blossoms, with whole petals and a small central gap.

designs.name: Celestial seal
designs.description: A soft four-point star inside a single ring; a restrained companion to North star.

designs.name: North star
designs.description: Four bold points and a single broad ring; no compass ticks or miniature decoration.

designs.name: Compass
designs.description: A vintage compass medallion, with a finely ruled frame.
